title: Alizarin, an Agonist of AHR Receptor, Enhances CYP1A1 Enzyme Activity and Induces Transcriptional Changes in Hepatoma Cells.
authors: Liang, Shengxian; Bo, Haimei; Zhang, Yue; Zhen, Hongcheng; Zhong, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茜素通过AHR受体激活CYP1A1通路并引起转录变化，虽涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The phytopigment alizarin was previously characterized as an anti-tumor drug owing to its antioxidant or antigenotoxic activities. However, the safety of alizarin is currently still under dispute. In this study, we explored the activity of alizarin in the AHR-CYP1A1 pathway and analyzed the transcriptional changes affected by alizarin using human hepatoma cell line HepG2-based assays. The results showed that alizarin decreased HepG2 cell viability in a dose-dependent manner, with IC(50) values between 160.4 and 216.8 muM. Furthermore, alizarin significantly upregulated the expression of CYP1A1 and increased the ethoxyresorufin-O-deethylase activity. Alizarin also exhibited agonistic activity toward the AHR receptor in the XRE-mediated luciferase reporter gene assay, which was further confirmed via the molecular docking assay. In addition, the transcriptional analysis indicated that alizarin may act as a potential carcinogen through significantly enriching several items related to cancer in both DO and KEGG analysis. In brief, our findings indicated that alizarin shows agonistic activities to the AHR receptor through activating the AHR-CYP1A1 signaling pathway in HepG2 cells, which may lead to the risks for cancer developing.
abstract_zh: 植物色素茜素（alizarin）此前因其抗氧化或抗基因毒性活性而被表征为一种抗肿瘤药物。然而，茜素的安全性目前仍存在争议。在本研究中，我们探讨了茜素在AHR-CYP1A1通路中的活性，并利用人肝癌细胞系HepG2为基础的实验分析了茜素引起的转录变化。结果表明，茜素以剂量依赖性方式降低HepG2细胞活力，其IC(50)值介于160.4至216.8 μM之间。此外，茜素显著上调CYP1A1的表达，并增加乙氧基试卤灵-O-脱乙基酶活性。在XRE介导的荧光素酶报告基因实验中，茜素还对AHR受体表现出激动活性，这一结果通过分子对接实验进一步得到证实。另外，转录分析表明，在DO和KEGG分析中，茜素可能通过显著富集多个与癌症相关的条目而作为潜在致癌物。总之，我们的研究结果表明，茜素通过激活HepG2细胞中的AHR-CYP1A1信号通路对AHR受体表现出激动活性，这可能带来癌症发展的风险。
